 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially declared the  SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026 Out on its newly updated official web portal. Candidates who appeared for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026 Tier 1 computer-based test can now log in to access their individual response sheets, question papers, and provisional answer keys.
 Checking your recorded responses against the official answer key helps you estimate your raw marks accurately before the official Tier 1 cutoff and merit lists are published.
 SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026 Out: Live Updates and Key Facts
 The preliminary key and response window were activated on November 4, 2026 . Below is the summary of key timelines and official parameters:
 Exam Conducting Body: Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
 Exam Name: Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (Tier 1)
 SSC CGL 2026 Exam Dates: September 30 to October 28, 2026
 Status: SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026 Out
 Release Date: November 4, 2026
 Ob jection Window: November 4, 2026 (9:00 PM) to November 7, 2026 (9:00 PM)
 Objection Fee: ₹50 per question/answer challenged
 Official Website : ssc.gov.in 
 SSC CGL Answer Key Out
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 on November 4, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination can check and download their provisional answer key and response sheet from the official website, ssc.gov.in.
 SSC CGL Tier 1 Response Sheet 2026 Download Link
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC CGL Tier 1 Response Sheet 2026 on November 4, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination can access and download their response sheets along with the provisional answer key by visiting the official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates need to log in using their registration number and password to check their recorded responses and calculate their expected scores.
 SSC CGL Tier 1 Response Sheet 2026 Download Link 
 How to Download Your SSC CGL Tier 1 Response Sheet 2026
 Follow these simple steps to download SSC CGL response sheet PDF from the official portal:
 Visit the Official Portal: Go to the official Staff Selection Commission website
 Access Candidate Login: Click on the Login / Register button on the homepage header.
 Submit Credentials: Enter your User ID (Roll Number as per your admission certificate) and Password.
 Locate Answer Key Link: Click on the link titled "Combined Graduate Level Examination (Tier-I) 2026: Uploading of Tentative Answer Keys along with Candidates' Response Sheet(s)" .
 View and Save PDF: Your question paper with your chosen options and the commission’s correct answers will open on the screen. Download and save the document for score calculation and future reference.
 SSC CGL Tier 1 Marking Scheme and Score Calculation Method
 Calculating your tentative score using the response sheet is straightforward. The Tier 1 exam consists of 100 questions carrying a total of 200 marks.To understand the minimum marks required for selection, candidates can refer to the SSC CGL Cut Off for category-wise and post-wise qualifying marks.
 Correct Answer: +2 marks
 Incorrect Answer: -0.50 marks (Negative Marking)
 Unattempted Question: 0 marks
 {Raw Score} = ({Total Correct Responses} X 2) - {Total Incorrect Responses} X 0.50) 
 Step-by-Step Guide to Raise Objections Against SSC CGL Provisional Key 
 If you spot an error in the answer key released by the commission, you can challenge it online before the cutoff time, check here how to raise objection againts SSC CGL answer key 2026 -
 Objection Deadline: Submit challenges by November 7, 2026, up to 9:00 PM . Submissions after 9:00 PM will not be reviewed.
 Challenge Fee: A non-refundable processing fee of ₹50 per question challenged must be paid online.
 Supporting Documents: Upload authentic, reliable reference material (such as standard NCERT textbooks or official government publications) to validate your objection.
 Candidates can check the SSC CGL Salary details to understand the post-wise salary structure, pay scale, grade pay, and allowances offered to selected candidates.
 SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026: FAQs
 When was the SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026 released?
 The Staff Selection Commission released the Tier 1 response sheet and tentative answer key on November 4, 2026. What is the deadline to challenge the SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026?
 Candidates can raise challenges online through ssc.gov.in from November 4 (9:00 PM) to November 7, 2026 (9:00 PM). How much is the fee for raising an objection against the SSC CGL answer key?
 The fee is ₹50 per question/answer challenged, payable online via net banking, UPI, or credit/debit cards. Have questions about your prep?
